hadiths.arabic_text: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى ، عَنْ مَالِك ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ ، وَعَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " قَضَى بِالشُّفْعَةِ فِيمَا لَمْ يُقْسَمْ بَيْنَ الشُّرَكَاءِ ، فَإِذَا وَقَعَتِ الْحُدُودُ بَيْنَهُمْ فَلَا شُفْعَةَ فِيهِ " . قَالَ مَالِك : وَعَلَى ذَلِكَ السُّنَّةُ الَّتِي لَا اخْتِلَافَ فِيهَا عِنْدَنَا
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab and Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled concerning pre-emption (shuf'ah) in what has not been divided among partners, but when boundaries have been established between them, there is no pre-emption in it. Malik said: This is the sunna upon which there is no disagreement among us.

hadiths.arabic_text: قَالَ مَالِك : إِنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ ، أَنَّ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ سُئِلَ عَنِ الشُّفْعَةِ هَلْ فِيهَا مِنْ سُنَّةٍ ؟ فَقَالَ : " نَعَمْ ، الشُّفْعَةُ فِي الدُّورِ وَالْأَرَضِينَ ، وَلَا تَكُونُ إِلَّا بَيْنَ الشُّرَكَاءِ " . وَحَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ ، مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ . قَالَ مَالِك ، فِي رَجُلٍ اشْتَرَى شِقْصًا مَعَ قَوْمٍ فِي أَرْضٍ بِحَيَوَانٍ عَبْدٍ أَوْ وَلِيدَةٍ ، أَوْ مَا أَشْبَهَ ذَلِكَ مِنَ الْعُرُوضِ ، فَجَاءَ الشَّرِيكُ يَأْخُذُ بِشُفْعَتِهِ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ ، فَوَجَدَ الْعَبْدَ أَوِ الْوَلِيدَةَ قَدْ هَلَكَا ، وَلَمْ يَعْلَمْ أَحَدٌ قَدْرَ قِيمَتِهِمَا ، فَيَقُولُ الْمُشْتَرِي : قِيمَةُ الْعَبْدِ أَوِ الْوَلِيدَةِ مِائَةُ دِينَارٍ ، وَيَقُولُ صَاحِبُ الشُّفْعَةِ الشَّرِيكُ : بَلْ قِيمَتُهَا خَمْسُونَ دِينَارًا . قَالَ مَالِك : يَحْلِفُ الْمُشْتَرِي أَنَّ قِيمَةَ مَا اشْتَرَى بِهِ مِائَةُ دِينَارٍ ، ثُمَّ إِنْ شَاءَ أَنْ يَأْخُذَ صَاحِبُ الشُّفْعَةِ أَخَذَ أَوْ يَتْرُكَ ، إِلَّا أَنْ يَأْتِيَ الشَّفِيعُ بِبَيِّنَةٍ أَنَّ قِيمَةَ الْعَبْدِ أَوِ الْوَلِيدَةِ دُونَ مَا قَالَ الْمُشْتَرِي . قَالَ مَالِك : مَنْ وَهَبَ شِقْصًا فِي دَارٍ أَوْ أَرْضٍ مُشْتَرَكَةٍ ، فَأَثَابَهُ الْمَوْهُوبُ لَهُ بِهَا نَقْدًا أَوْ عَرْضًا ، فَإِنَّ الشُّرَكَاءَ يَأْخُذُونَهَا بِالشُّفْعَةِ إِنْ شَاءُوا ، وَيَدْفَعُونَ إِلَى الْمَوْهُوبِ لَهُ قِيمَةَ مَثُوبَتِهِ دَنَانِيرَ أَوْ دَرَاهِمَ
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated that Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab was asked about pre-emption whether there is a sunna concerning it. He said: Yes, pre-emption is in houses and lands, and it only occurs between partners. And it reached Malik from Sulayman ibn Yasar something similar to that. Malik said regarding a man who bought a share with people in land with an animal - a slave or a slave-girl - or something similar to that from goods, then the partner came to take his pre-emption after that, and found the slave or slave-girl had died, and no one knew their value...

hadiths.arabic_text: بَابُ مَا لَا تَقَعُ فِيهِ الشُّفْعَةُ
hadiths.english_translation: Chapter: What Pre-emption Does Not Apply To
hadiths.note: This is a chapter heading, not a hadith narration

hadiths.arabic_text: قَالَ يَحْيَى : قَالَ مَالِك : عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُمَارَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ حَزْمٍ ، أَنَّ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ عَفَّانَ ، قَالَ : " إِذَا وَقَعَتِ الْحُدُودُ فِي الْأَرْضِ ، فَلَا شُفْعَةَ فِيهَا ، وَلَا شُفْعَةَ فِي بِئْرٍ وَلَا فِي فَحْلِ النَّخْلِ " . قَالَ مَالِك : وَعَلَى هَذَا الْأَمْرُ عِنْدَنَا
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated that Uthman ibn Affan said: When boundaries have been established in land, there is no pre-emption in it, and there is no pre-emption in a well nor in a stud palm. Malik said: This is the practice among us.

hadiths.english_translation: Chapter: Encouragement to Judge with Truth
hadiths.note: This is a chapter heading, not a hadith narration

hadiths.arabic_text: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى ، عَنْ مَالِك ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ، قَالَ : " إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ ، وَإِنَّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُونَ إِلَيَّ ، فَلَعَلَّ بَعْضَكُمْ أَنْ يَكُونَ أَلْحَنَ بِحُجَّتِهِ مِنْ بَعْضٍ ، فَأَقْضِيَ لَهُ عَلَى نَحْوِ مَا أَسْمَعُ مِنْهُ ، فَمَنْ قَضَيْتُ لَهُ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ حَقِّ أَخِيهِ ، فَلَا يَأْخُذَنَّ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا ، فَإِنَّمَا أَقْطَعُ لَهُ قِطْعَةً مِنَ النَّارِ "
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Umm Salamah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: I am only a human being, and you bring your disputes to me. Perhaps some of you are more eloquent in presenting his argument than others, so I judge in his favor according to what I hear from him. So whoever I judge for him something from his brother's right, let him not take anything from it, for I am only cutting for him a piece of the Fire.

hadiths.arabic_text: وَحَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ " اخْتَصَمَ إِلَيْهِ مُسْلِمٌ وَيَهُودِيٌّ ، فَرَأَى عُمَرُ أَنَّ الْحَقَّ لِلْيَهُودِيِّ ، فَقَضَى لَهُ . فَقَالَ لَهُ الْيَهُودِيُّ : وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ قَضَيْتَ بِالْحَقِّ . فَضَرَبَهُ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ بِالدِّرَّةِ ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ ؟ " فَقَالَ لَهُ الْيَهُودِيُّ : إِنَّا نَجِدُ أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ قَاضٍ يَقْضِي بِالْحَقِّ ، إِلَّا كَانَ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ مَلَكٌ ، وَعَنْ شِمَالِهِ مَلَكٌ ، يُسَدِّدَانِهِ وَيُوَفِّقَانِهِ لِلْحَقِّ مَا دَامَ مَعَ الْحَقِّ ، فَإِذَا تَرَكَ الْحَقَّ عَرَجَا وَتَرَكَاهُ "
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab: A Muslim and a Jew brought a dispute to Umar ibn al-Khattab. Umar saw that the truth was with the Jew, so he judged in his favor. The Jew said to him: By Allah, you have judged with truth. So Umar ibn al-Khattab struck him with a whip, then said: How do you know? The Jew said to him: We find that there is no judge who judges with truth except that there is an angel on his right and an angel on his left, guiding him and directing him to the truth as long as he is with the truth. But when he leaves the truth, they ascend and leave him.

hadiths.english_translation: Chapter: What Has Come Concerning Testimonies
hadiths.note: This is a chapter heading, not a hadith narration

hadiths.arabic_text: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى ، عَنْ مَالِك ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ ، عَنْ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ، قَالَ : " أَلَا أُخْبِرُكُمْ بِخَيْرِ الشُّهَدَاءِ ، الَّذِي يَأْتِي بِشَهَادَتِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُسْأَلَهَا ، أَوْ يُخْبِرُ بِشَهَادَتِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُسْأَلَهَا "
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Zayd ibn Khalid al-Juhani: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Shall I not inform you of the best of witnesses? The one who brings his testimony before he is asked for it, or informs of his testimony before he is asked for it.

hadiths.arabic_text: وَحَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : قَدِمَ عَلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِرَاقِ ، فَقَالَ : لَقَدْ جِئْتُكَ لِأَمْرٍ مَا لَهُ رَأْسٌ وَلَا ذَنَبٌ . فَقَالَ عُمَرُ : " مَا هُوَ ؟ " قَالَ : شَهَادَاتُ الزُّورِ ظَهَرَتْ بِأَرْضِنَا . فَقَالَ عُمَرُ : " أَوَ قَدْ كَانَ ذَلِكَ ؟ " قَالَ : نَعَمْ . فَقَالَ عُمَرُ : " وَاللَّهِ لَا يُؤْسَرُ رَجُلٌ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ بِغَيْرِ الْعُدُولِ "
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated that Rabi'ah ibn Abi Abd al-Rahman said: A man from the people of Iraq came to Umar ibn al-Khattab and said: I have come to you about a matter that has no beginning and no end. Umar said: What is it? He said: False testimonies have appeared in our land. Umar said: Has that really happened? He said: Yes. So Umar said: By Allah, no man in Islam shall be bound except by upright witnesses.

hadiths.arabic_text: قَالَ يَحْيَى : عَنْ مَالِك أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ ، وَغَيْرِهِ ، أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا يَقُولُونَ : " لَا تَجُوزُ شَهَادَةُ الْمَحْدُودِ فِي الْقَذْفِ أَبَدًا ، وَإِنْ تَابَ "
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated that it reached Malik from Sulayman ibn Yasar and others that they used to say: The testimony of one who has been punished for false accusation (qadhf) is never acceptable, even if he repents.
